benefit: ₹600 monthly financial assistance to the caregiver
description_en: Financial aid for caregivers of severely disabled patients

eligibility: BPL and APL families facing catastrophic illnesses (Cancer, Kidney, Heart, Brain)
benefit: Medical grant up to ₹2,00,000 for critical illness treatment
description_en: Financial assistance for critical illnesses (Cancer, Cardiac, Kidney)
description_local: മാരക രോഗങ്ങൾക്കുള്ള സാമ്പത്തിക ചികിത്സാ സഹായം

eligibility: Adults residing in urban local bodies willing to do unskilled manual work
benefit: 100 days of guaranteed wage employment per household per year
description_en: Guaranteed 100 days of urban employment for unskilled labor

eligibility: Farmers and landowners participating in food security agriculture projects
benefit: Subsidies for integrated farming, seeds, and fertilizer supplies
description_en: Food security scheme offering subsidies for integrated farming
description_local: സംയോജിത കൃഷിക്കുള്ള സബ്സിഡികൾ നൽകുന്ന ഭക്ഷ്യ സുരക്ഷാ പദ്ധതി

eligibility: Widows, divorced, or deserted women starting self-employment
benefit: Loan up to ₹50,000 with 50% subsidy (up to ₹25,000)
description_en: Self-employment assistance for destitute women and widows
description_local: വിധവകൾക്കും നിരാലംബരായ സ്ത്രീകൾക്കുമുള്ള സ്വയംതൊഴിൽ സഹായം

name_en: Chief Minister's Girl Child Protection Scheme
eligibility: Families with one or two girl children and no male child, parents must have undergone sterilization.
benefit: Fixed deposit of ₹50,000 for one girl child or ₹25,000 each for two girl children, maturing at age 18.
steps: Apply at e-Seva centre or District Social Welfare Office
Approval and fixed deposit bond issuance
description_en: Promoting the welfare of girl children and preventing female infanticide.
description_local: பெண் குழந்தைகளின் நலனை மேம்படுத்துதல் மற்றும் பெண் சிசுக்கொலையைத் தடுத்தல்.

name_en: Dr. Dharmambal Ammaiyar Memorial Widow Remarriage Assistance
name_local: டாக்டர் தர்மாம்பாள் அம்மையார் நினைவு விதவை மறுமண நிதி உதவி
eligibility: Widows remarrying. No income ceiling. Minimum age criteria apply.
benefit: ₹15,000 to ₹50,000 financial assistance and a 8 gram gold coin for making Thirumangalyam.
steps: Submit certificates to District Social Welfare Office
description_en: Financial assistance to encourage widow remarriage and provide social security.
description_local: விதவை மறுமணத்தை ஊக்குவிக்கவும் சமூக பாதுகாப்பை வழங்கவும் நிதி உதவி.

name_en: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Memorial Marriage Assistance Scheme
name_local: மூவலூர் ராமாமிர்தம் அம்மையார் நினைவு திருமண உதவித் திட்டம்
eligibility: Poor girls matching minimum educational qualifications (10th pass for general, 5th for ST).
benefit: ₹25,000 to ₹50,000 cheque and 8 gram gold coin for Thirumangalyam.
steps: Cheque and gold coin provided before marriage
description_en: Marriage assistance to help poor parents and encourage female education.
description_local: ஏழை பெற்றோருக்கு திருமண உதவி மற்றும் பெண் கல்வியை ஊக்குவித்தல்.

name_en: EVR Maniammaiyar Memorial Orphan Girl Marriage Assistance
name_local: ஈ.வெ.ரா. மணியம்மையார் நினைவு ஆதரவற்ற மகளிர் திருமண உதவித் திட்டம்
eligibility: Orphan girls who have lost both parents. No income limit.
benefit: ₹25,000 to ₹50,000 (degree holders) + 8g gold coin.
description_en: Marriage assistance specially aimed at orphan girls.
description_local: ஆதரவற்ற பெண்களுக்கான சிறப்பு திருமண உதவி.

name_en: Chief Minister's Solar Powered Green House Scheme (CMSPGHS)
name_local: முதலமைச்சரின் சூரிய சக்தி பசுமை வீடுகள் திட்டம்
eligibility: Poor people living in rural areas without a proper concrete house.
benefit: Free concrete house measuring 300 sq.ft with solar-powered home lighting system.
description_en: Providing free solar-powered concrete houses to the rural poor.
description_local: கிராமப்புற ஏழைகளுக்கு இலவச சூரிய சக்தி கான்கிரீட் வீடுகளை வழங்குதல்.

name_en: Free Distribution of Milch Cows and Goats/Sheep
name_local: இலவச கறவை பசுக்கள் மற்றும் வெள்ளாடுகள்/செம்மறியாடுகள் வழங்கும் திட்டம்
eligibility: Poor landless agricultural laborers and marginalized families, prioritized for women.
benefit: 1 Milch Cow or 4 Goats/Sheep distributed free of cost.
steps: Distribution camp by Animal Husbandry dept
description_en: Boosting rural economy and daily income through livestock distribution.
description_local: கிராமப்புற பொருளாதாரம் மற்றும் தினசரி வருமானத்தை கால்நடைகள் மூலம் மேம்படுத்துதல்.

eligibility: All citizens above 30 years wishing to undergo preventive health screening.
benefit: Highly subsidized comprehensive health check-up packages starting from ₹1000.
steps: Book appointment at Government General Hospital
description_en: Preventive diagnostic screening at deeply subsidized rates in government hospitals.
description_local: அரசு மருத்துவமனைகளில் அதிக மானிய விலையில் முழு உடல் பரிசோதனை.

name_en: Anjugam Ammaiyar Memorial Inter-Caste Marriage Assistance
name_local: அஞ்சுகம் அம்மையார் நினைவு கலப்புத் திருமண நிதி உதவி
eligibility: Couples where one spouse belongs to SC/ST. No income ceiling.
benefit: ₹25,000 to ₹50,000 and 8g gold coin to promote a casteless society.
description_en: Financial assistance to encourage inter-caste marriages and abolish caste discrimination.
description_local: சாதி பாகுபாட்டை ஒழித்து கலப்பு திருமணங்களை ஊக்குவிக்க நிதி உதவி.

eligibility: School students in Class 1 to 8 in government and aided schools.
benefit: Free after-school remedial classes near their habitation by volunteers to bridge learning gaps.
documents: No formal documents needed for attendance
steps: Locate nearest ITK center in the village
Send children daily from 5 PM to 7 PM
description_en: After-school educational initiative to bridge learning gaps caused by the pandemic.
description_local: கற்றல் இடைவெளிகளை போக்க பள்ளி முடிந்த பின் மாலை நேர சிறப்பு வகுப்புகள்.

eligibility: Rural poor women forming Self Help Groups (SHGs).
benefit: Capacity building, seed money, and linkage to bank credit up to ₹10-20 Lakhs for group enterprises.
steps: Receive revolving fund and apply for bank linkage
description_en: Empowering women by helping them start micro-enterprises through SHGs.
description_local: சுய உதவிக் குழுக்கள் மூலம் பெண்களுக்கு நுண் தொழில் தொடங்க உதவி.

eligibility: SC, ST, BC, Minorities, Disabled, and Construction Workers. Bride must be 18+, Groom 21+, both minimum 10th pass.
benefit: Financial assistance ranging from ₹40,000 to ₹1,50,000 based on the caste combination.
steps: Apply at Village/Ward Secretariat within 60 days of marriage
description_en: Financial assistance for marriages of poor marginalized families to promote education and prevent child marriage.
description_local: బాల్య వివాహాలను నిరోధించడానికి మరియు పేద కుటుంబాలకు వివాహ ఆర్థిక సహాయం.

eligibility: Women belonging to Kapu, Balija, Telaga, and Ontari communities.
benefit: ₹15,000 per annum for five years to enhance their livelihood and living standards.
description_en: Financial support to women from specific forward castes to improve business/livelihoods.
description_local: కాపు, బలిజ, తెలగ, ఒంటరి సామాజిక వర్గాల మహిళలకు వ్యాపార/జీవనోపాధి ఆర్థిక మద్దతు.

eligibility: Junior Advocates enrolled in the State Bar Council within the last 3 years.
benefit: ₹5,000 per month stipend for 3 years.
description_en: Monthly stipend to support Junior Advocates during their initial practice years.
description_local: జూనియర్ న్యాయవాదులకు వారి ప్రారంభ ప్రాక్టీస్ సమయంలో మద్దతుగా నెలవారీ స్టైపెండ్.

eligibility: Students studying in classes 1 to 10 in Government/Aided schools.
benefit: Upgraded, highly nutritious mid-day meal with daily varying menus including ragi malt, jaggery, eggs, and peanut chikki.

Meals provided during lunch break autonomously
description_en: Enhanced mid-day meal scheme with a rich, daily changing menu to tackle malnutrition.
description_local: పోషకాహార లేమిని అరికట్టడానికి రుచికరమైన మరియు ఆరోగ్యవంతమైన మధ్యాహ్న భోజన పథకం.

eligibility: All students from class 1 to 10 in Government Schools.
benefit: Free student kit comprising 3 pairs of uniforms, textbooks, notebooks, school bag, shoes, socks, and dictionary.
description_en: Free distribution of essential educational materials kit to students at the start of the academic year.
description_local: విద్యా సంవత్సరం ప్రారంభంలో విద్యార్థులకు ఉచిత విద్యా కిట్.

eligibility: Rajakas (washermen), Nayee Brahmins (barbers), and Tailors from BPL families.
benefit: ₹10,000 per year one-time financial assistance.
description_en: Financial support for traditional artisans and service providers.
description_local: రజకులు, నాయీ బ్రాహ్మణులు, దర్జీలకు వార్షిక ఆర్థిక సహాయం.

eligibility: Pregnant women, lactating mothers, and children aged 6 months to 6 years.
benefit: Take Home Ration (THR) dry rations, milk, eggs, and hot cooked meals through Anganwadis.

description_local: గర్భిణీ స్త్రీలు, బాలింతలు మరియు చిన్నపిల్లలకు సంపూర్ణ పోషకాహారం.

eligibility: All citizens of Andhra Pradesh suffering from vision problems.
benefit: Free eye screenings, free spectacles, and free cataract/eye surgeries.
steps: Attend screening camp in your ward/school
description_en: Universal free eye care scheme covering screening to surgeries.
description_local: ఉచిత కంటి పరీక్షలు, కళ్లద్దాలు మరియు శస్త్రచికిత్సలు.

eligibility: Poor women from Economically Backward Classes (EBC) / Forward castes.
benefit: ₹15,000 per annum financial assistance for up to 3 years.
description_en: Financial assistance to poor unreserved caste women to support their livelihood.
description_local: ఆర్థికంగా వెనుకబడిన తరగతుల (ఓసీ) మహిళలకు ఆర్థిక సహాయం.

benefit: Developed plots offered at highly subsidized, below-market prices to Middle Income Groups (MIG).

description_local: మధ్యతరగతి ప్రజలకు సరసమైన ధరలలో క్లియర్ టైటిల్ తో కూడిన ప్లాట్లు.

eligibility: Girl child born in BPL families. Maximum of two girls per family.
benefit: Fixed deposit of ₹19,300, maturing to ₹1,00,000+ when she turns 18. Also provides health insurance & scholarships.

description_local: ಹೆಣ್ಣು ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಭವಿಷ್ಯ ಹಾಗೂ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಭದ್ರತೆಗಾಗಿ ಬಾಂಡ್.

eligibility: Minority community (Muslim, Christian, Jain, etc.) brides from BPL families.
benefit: ₹50,000 financial assistance for marriage expenses.
description_en: Financial assistance for the marriage of poor girls belonging to minority communities.
description_local: ಅಲ್ಪಸಂಖ್ಯಾತ ಸಮುದಾಯದ ಬಡ ಹೆಣ್ಣುಮಕ್ಕಳ ಮದುವೆಗೆ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಸಹಾಯ.

eligibility: Small/Marginal farmers belonging to SC/ST/OBC categories.
benefit: Free borewell drilling, pump-set installation, and electrification for agricultural land.
steps: Apply at respective Corporation (e.g. Ambedkar Dev Corp)
description_en: Providing irrigation facilities to farmers by drilling borewells at government cost.
description_local: ರೈತರ ಜಮೀನಿಗೆ ನೀರಾವರಿ ಒದಗಿಸಲು ಉಚಿತ ಕೊಳವೆ ಬಾವಿ ನಿರ್ಮಾಣ.

eligibility: Farmers in dry-land and drought-prone regions.
benefit: Subsidies ranging from 80-90% for constructing farm ponds (Krishi Hondas), polythene lining, and diesel pumps.

description_local: ಒಣಭೂಮಿ ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಕೃಷಿ ಹೊಂಡ ನಿರ್ಮಾಣಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಸಬ್ಸಿಡಿ.

eligibility: Children going to Anganwadis and Government/Aided schools (Classes 1-10).
benefit: Free hot milk (150 ml) provided 5 days a week in schools/Anganwadis.
description_en: Providing milk to school children to combat malnutrition and prevent calcium deficiency.
description_local: ಶಾಲಾ ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅಂಗನವಾಡಿ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಉಚಿತ ಹಾಲು ವಿತರಣೆ.

eligibility: BPL households not covered under the central PM Ujjwala Scheme.
benefit: Free LPG gas connection, a twin-burner gas stove, and two free refill cylinders.
steps: Apply at local Gram Panchayat or Nada Kacheri
Verification of no existing LPG connection
description_en: Providing clean cooking fuel (LPG connections) to BPL families to protect women's health.
description_local: ಬಿಪಿಎಲ್ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳಿಗೆ ಉಚಿತ ಅಡುಗೆ ಅನಿಲ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಟವ್.

eligibility: Small/marginal farmers and agricultural laborers.
benefit: Highly subsidized bank loans (33% for General, 50% for SC/ST) for purchasing cattle, sheep, goats, or poultry.
steps: Apply through Dept of Animal Husbandry
Subsidy deposited directly to loan account
description_en: Subsidized loans for livestock farming to boost allied agricultural income.
description_local: ರೈತರಿಗೆ ಹೈನುಗಾರಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕುರಿ-ಕೋಳಿ ಸಾಕಾಣಿಕೆಗೆ ಸಬ್ಸಿಡಿ ಸಾಲ.

eligibility: Unemployed rural youth.
benefit: Free skill training + financial assistance to start self-employment ventures.
steps: Avail bank linkage to start enterprise
description_en: Training and guiding unemployed rural youth to become self-reliant entrepreneurs.
description_local: ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ನಿರುದ್ಯೋಗಿ ಯುವಕರಿಗೆ ಕೌಶಲ್ಯ ತರಬೇತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ವಯಂ ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನ.

eligibility: Students from minority communities pursuing professional courses (Medical, Engineering, etc.) through CET/NEET.
benefit: Education loan from ₹50,000 to ₹3,00,000 per year at an ultra-low 2% interest rate.
steps: Apply to Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation
description_en: Low-interest educational loans for minority students pursuing professional degrees.
description_local: ವೃತ್ತಿಪರ ಕೋರ್ಸ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ವ್ಯಾಸಂಗ ಮಾಡುವ ಅಲ್ಪಸಂಖ್ಯಾತ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ಸಾಲ.

eligibility: Hindu couples getting married under mass marriage events conducted by Muzrai department temples.
benefit: 8 gram gold mangalsutra, ₹10,000 fixed deposit for bride, ₹5,000 cash for groom, and wedding expenses covered.
steps: Register at A-grade state temple 30 days prior
description_en: Mass marriage scheme offering financial support and gold to couples to reduce wedding debt.
description_local: ಮುಜರಾಯಿ ದೇವಾಲಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಮೂಹಿಕ ವಿವಾಹವಾಗುವ ದಂಪತಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಚಿನ್ನ ಮತ್ತು ನಗದು.

eligibility: Senior citizens residing in corporation/municipality areas.
benefit: Free mobile clinics, supply of free medicines, palliative care, and counseling.
steps: Attend mobile clinic camps in your ward
description_en: Providing healthcare and support services to the elderly residing in urban areas.
description_local: നഗരപ്രദേശങ്ങളിലെ മുതിർന്ന പൗരന്മാർക്ക് സൗജന്യ വൈദ്യസഹായവും മരുന്നും.

eligibility: Unwed mothers facing severe social and financial hardship.
benefit: ₹1,000 monthly financial assistance.
steps: Apply via Child Development Project Officer (CDPO)
description_en: Monthly pension ensuring the social and financial security of unwed mothers.
description_local: അവിവാഹിതരായ അമ്മമാർക്ക് സാമ്പത്തിക പരിരക്ഷ നൽകുന്ന മാസ പെൻഷൻ.

eligibility: Children below 18 years requiring treatment for critical diseases (kidney, heart, cerebral palsy) and cannot afford it.
benefit: Free treatment at major government hospitals (up to ₹50,000 initially, extendable up to ₹1 Lakh).
documents: BPL/Income certificate (preferred but flexed for life-threatening cases)
steps: Admit child in Medical College Hospital
description_en: Free treatment for kids under 18 suffering from fatal diseases.
description_local: മാരക രോഗങ്ങളുള്ള കുട്ടികൾക്ക് സർക്കാർ മെഡിക്കൽ കോളേജുകളിൽ സൗജന്യ ചികിത്സ.

eligibility: Women delivering babies in government hospitals.
benefit: Free taxi drop-back service from the hospital to their homes after childbirth.
steps: Free taxi is arranged by the hospital
description_en: Ensuring safe transit by providing free cabs for mothers and newborns returning home.
description_local: പ്രസവശേഷം അമ്മയ്ക്കും കുഞ്ഞിനും വീട്ടിലേക്ക് മടങ്ങാൻ സൗജന്യ ടാക്സി വിതരണം.

eligibility: Widows and legally divorced women getting remarried to overcome social stigma.
benefit: One-time financial assistance of ₹25,000.
steps: Apply online or via CDPO within 6 months of marriage
description_en: Promoting the remarriage of widows and divorced women through financial aid.
description_local: വിധവകൾക്കും വിവാഹമോചിതർക്കും പുനർവിവാഹത്തിന് സാമ്പത്തിക സഹായം.

eligibility: Differently abled students studying in 9th degree/ITI.
benefit: Financial aid ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹1,500 for purchasing uniforms, study materials, and paying fees.
steps: Apply via District Social Justice Officer
description_en: Financial assistance to physically challenged students for purchasing study materials.
description_local: ഭിന്നശേഷിക്കാരായ വിദ്യാർത്ഥികൾക്ക് പഠനോപകരണങ്ങൾ വാങ്ങാൻ സാമ്പത്തിക സഹായം.

eligibility: Widows of highly indebted farmers / farmers who committed suicide.
benefit: Financial assistance to clear debts and engage in self-employment ventures.
description_en: Helping destitute widows of debt-ridden farmers rebuild their lives.
description_local: കടക്കെണിയിലായ കർഷകരുടെ വിധവകൾക്ക് ബാധ്യതകൾ തീർക്കാനും പുതിയ ജീവിതം തുടങ്ങാനുമുള്ള ധനസഹായം.

eligibility: Mothers of severely disabled or mentally retarded children.
benefit: Subsidized loan up to ₹35,000 to start self-employment while stationed at home.
description_en: Self-employment assistance to mothers of severely disabled children.
description_local: തീവ്ര വൈകല്യമുള്ള കുട്ടികളുടെ അമ്മമാർക്ക് വീട്ടിലിരുന്ന് ചെയ്യാവുന്ന സ്വയം തൊഴിലിന് സഹായം.

eligibility: Any citizen, special subsidies for destitute.
benefit: Nutritious full-course lunch available for just ₹20.
steps: Walk into any Kudumbashree Janakeeya Hotel
description_en: Providing high-quality meals at highly subsidized rates (₹20) to ensure no one starves.
description_local: വെറും 20 രൂപയ്ക്ക് ഗുണനിലവാരമുള്ള ഉച്ചഭക്ഷണം ലഭ്യമാക്കുന്ന പദ്ധതി.

eligibility: Individuals requiring emergency expensive treatments like organ transplant, not covered by existing schemes.
benefit: Crowdfunded and government-backed financial assistance for ultra-expensive surgeries.
steps: Apply at Kerala Social Security Mission portal
description_en: Financial aid for extremely expensive surgeries like heart or kidney transplants.
description_local: അവയവം മാറ്റിവെക്കൽ പോലുള്ള വലിയ ചെലവുള്ള ലക്ഷക്കണക്കിന് രൂപയുടെ ചികിത്സകൾക്ക് സഹായം.

name_en: Free Bus Travel for Women in Tamil Nadu Cities
name_local: தமிழ்நாடு நகரங்களில் பெண்களுக்கு இலவச பேருந்து பயணம்
eligibility: All women (18+) in Tamil Nadu can travel free in MTC Chennai and TNSTC city buses
benefit: Completely free travel in MTC Chennai buses and TNSTC city buses. Women can board with just Aadhaar or any ID.
documents: Any government-issued ID (Aadhaar, Voter ID, etc.)
steps: Board any MTC or TNSTC city bus
description_en: Tamil Nadu government provides completely free bus travel for all women in city buses including MTC Chennai — simply show ID and travel!
description_local: தமிழ்நாடு அரசு MTC சென்னை மற்றும் நகர பேருந்துகளில் அனைத்து பெண்களுக்கும் இலவச பயணம் — அடையாள சான்றை காட்டி பயணிக்கலாம்!

name_en: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam – Women Income Scheme
name_local: கலைஞர் மகளிர் உரிமைத் திட்டம் – மாதாந்திர வருமான திட்டம்
eligibility: Women above 21 years from families with annual income below Rs 2.5 lakh with ration card
benefit: Rs 1,000 per month directly transferred to woman's bank account
steps: Visit tn.gov.in or nearest Arasu centre
Fill online or offline application form
Monthly amount credited to registered bank account
description_en: Monthly income of Rs 1000 for women from low-income families in Tamil Nadu — empowering women with financial independence
description_local: குறைந்த வருமான குடும்பங்களில் உள்ள பெண்களுக்கு மாதந்தோறும் ₹1000 வருமானம் — பெண்களுக்கு நிதி சுதந்திரம்

name_en: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance
eligibility: Unmarried girls from families with income below Rs 72,000/year who completed at least 10th standard
benefit: Rs 50,000 cash + 8 grams gold thali + household items worth Rs 25,000
steps: Apply at District Social Welfare Office or tn.gov.in
Receive assistance on or before wedding date
description_en: Marriage assistance for poor girls who completed 10th grade — Rs 50,000 cash + gold + household items
description_local: 10ம் வகுப்பு படித்த ஏழை பெண்களுக்கு திருமண உதவி — ₹50,000 பணம் + தாலி + வீட்டு உபயோக பொருட்கள்

name_local: வனிதா உதவி மையம் மற்றும் பாதுகாப்பு திட்டம் (181)
eligibility: All women in Tamil Nadu experiencing domestic violence, harassment, or distress
benefit: Immediate police assistance, free legal aid, shelter home access, counseling — 24x7 Helpline 181
documents: No documents required for initial contact
steps: Explain your situation to the helpline officer
Access to free shelter, legal aid, and counseling
description_en: Free 24/7 women's safety helpline (dial 181) — immediate police and legal help for domestic violence or harassment in Tamil Nadu
description_local: 24/7 பெண்கள் பாதுகாப்பு உதவி எண் (181 அழைக்கவும்) — குடும்ப வன்முறை அல்லது துன்புறுத்தலுக்கு உடனடி போலீஸ் உதவி

name_en: Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Maternity Benefit Scheme
name_local: டாக்டர் முத்துலட்சுமி ரெட்டி மகப்பேறு நலத் திட்டம்
eligibility: Pregnant women from BPL/low-income families with annual income below Rs 72,000
benefit: Rs 18,000 cash for 1st delivery, Rs 12,000 for 2nd delivery — covers nutrition and hospital expenses
steps: Register at nearest Primary Health Centre
Amount credited in installments during and after pregnancy
description_en: Maternity cash benefit up to Rs 18,000 for poor pregnant women for nutrition and hospital expenses
description_local: ஏழை கர்ப்பிணிகளுக்கு ஊட்டச்சத்து மற்றும் மருத்துவமனை செலவுக்காக ₹18,000 மகப்பேறு ஊக்கத்தொகை

eligibility: Unemployed women from SC/ST communities with annual income below Rs 2 lakh in Tamil Nadu
benefit: Rs 1 lakh grant for starting a business + free skill training + market linkage support
steps: Apply at District SC/ST Corporation office or tn.gov.in
description_en: Rs 1 lakh startup grant for SC/ST unemployed women to launch small businesses with free training
description_local: சிறு தொழில் தொடங்க SC/ST வேலையில்லா பெண்களுக்கு ₹1 லட்சம் மானியம், இலவச பயிற்சியுடன்

name_en: Tamil Nadu Women's Development Corporation Low-Interest Loan
eligibility: Women from all communities with annual income below Rs 3 lakh. Preference to widows, divorcees, and differently-abled women.
benefit: Low-interest loans from Rs 50,000 to Rs 5 lakh at 4% interest for micro businesses
steps: Visit Tamil Nadu Corporation for Development of Women office
description_en: Subsidized micro-business loans for women at just 4% interest through Women's Development Corporation of Tamil Nadu
description_local: தமிழ்நாடு பெண்கள் மேம்பாட்டு நிறுவனம் வாயிலாக பெண்களுக்கு 4% வட்டியில் சிறு தொழில் கடன்

eligibility: Girl students who studied in government schools and scored above 60% in 12th standard and are pursuing higher education
benefit: Rs 1,000 per month scholarship directly to girl student's bank account until completion of degree
steps: Upload 12th mark sheet and college enrollment proof
Monthly Rs 1000 credited to student's bank account
description_en: Rs 1000 monthly scholarship for girl students from government schools pursuing higher education in Tamil Nadu
description_local: அரசு பள்ளியில் படித்த மாணவிகளுக்கு உயர்கல்வியில் மாதந்தோறும் ₹1000 உதவித்தொகை

eligibility: Transgender individuals registered with Tamil Nadu Transgender Welfare Board with a TG certificate
benefit: Rs 1,000 monthly pension + free sex reassignment surgery at government hospitals + educational scholarships + free skill training
steps: Register with Tamil Nadu Transgender Welfare Board
Apply for pension at District Social Welfare Office
Monthly benefit credited to bank account
description_en: Comprehensive welfare for transgender persons including monthly pension, free surgery, scholarship and skill training
description_local: திருநங்கைகளுக்கு மாதாந்திர ஓய்வூதியம், இலவச அறுவை சிகிச்சை, கல்வி உதவித்தொகை மற்றும் திறன் பயிற்சி உள்ளிட்ட விரிவான நல திட்டம்
